body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **B**. It needs C4, the questionnaire's Module D Q39 unit code list, before any code change.
- `_MWI_FERT_UNIT_LABELS` (`malawi.py:2913`) reads the applied unit with the acquired code set (1 = Gram). But in the IHS3 and IHPS-2013 `.dta` the applied unit has no value labels (float64).
- The labelled acquired unit is mostly `kilogram`: IHS3 7,329 vs 253 `gram`; 2013-14 2,296 vs 162.
- Applied code 1 has median quantity 50 (IHS3, 5,098 slot-1 rows), and codes 1–4 have medians of 30–50.
- EPAR (`EPAR_UW_Malawi_IHS_W1.do:2123`, "already in kgs") and the WB panel treat the applied amount as kg.
- Served (2026-10-19): 13,302 inorganic-fertilizer rows at `u='Gram'`, median 50, carry 203.8 kg N; as kg they would carry 203,843.6, against Malawi's 840,235.8 total.
- A further **17,044** rows have a NULL `u`:
  - unmapped codes 0 and 8–12 (IHS3 code 12 alone is 4,764 slot-1 rows);
  - blank codes;
  - slot 2 in 2016-17 / 2019-20, whose unit column is not read (`unit2=None`).

  Per the #1041 ruling a missing unit is `U_UNKNOWN`, never NULL.
- Recorded in Malawi `CONTENTS.org`. It moves every Malawi hash, so bundle it with R4.

Not a residual: some Super D recorded under IHS code 5 would bias 0.08 slightly low. The IHS has no Super D code, so this cannot be measured; it is recorded in the code comment and in CONTENTS.org.

# 7. Proposed PR

**Title:** `nitrogen_kg: cited N shares for Ethiopia NPS (0.19) and Malawi D Compound (0.08); organic inputs refused, counted and named (GH #867)`

**Body:**

```markdown
Closes #867 as ruled (@ligon, 2026-10-18): "NPS and Malawi D Compound get CITED N shares (source in the code comment and the test). Organic inputs (manure, compost, organic fertilizer) get a documented refusal: they stay unmatched and loud (NutrientCoverageWarning), with no nominal share."
title: Malawi applied-fertilizer unit `ag_d39e`/`ag_d39j` probably misread — 13,302 rows served as grams carry 203.8 kg N that would be 203,843.6 kg as kilograms; 17,044 rows NULL `u`
